prompt.note: rendered system prompts equal this template with only its four {{...}} placeholders substituted (byte-checked at capture time)

wire_schema.derivation: canonical schema minus the single top-level "$schema" line and nothing else (reproducible; checked by verify_publication.py)
wire_schema.why: the Claude CLI --json-schema flag (Ajv draft-07 default) rejected the 2020-12 $schema URI before any model call

contract.cli_user_request_template: Audit the supplied test case under the system prompt. Research live sources with your web tools. Return the schema-valid audit; never write a headline score. The daily regimen is supplied for this test, not inferred from a photograph. Population: adult, health status unspecified; no other patient facts supplied. This is an experimental benchmark, not a human-verified medical assessment. Run time UTC: <timestamp>

scorer_baseline.note: the scorer was not modified; the cards were fed the unchanged evidence-ledger code at this baseline

run.auth: Claude.ai subscription through the local Claude Code CLI; API keys and alternative-provider variables stripped; no fallback model flag
run.flags: --safe-mode --strict-mcp-config --tools WebSearch,WebFetch --allowedTools WebSearch,WebFetch --permission-mode dontAsk --no-session-persistence --output-format stream-json --verbose --json-schema <wire schema> --system-prompt <rendered original prompt>
run.caps: no max-turns, no process timeout, no budget flag, no tool runtime caps
run.process: a fresh process per (case, model); the two models of a case ran concurrently
run.reruns_or_retries: none; zero harness-caused failures; 10 of 10 captures complete
run.web_tools_note: WebFetch returns a Haiku 4.5 summary of the page, not the verbatim page (caveat W1)

totals_all_10_captures.reading: 311 = 116 non-access + 21 Haiku refusals + at most 174 content-bearing Haiku summaries; 174 is an UPPER BOUND on content read, not papers read

images.composition_policy: only the 16 fully annotated compositions are published, each whole (the outside-the-card qualifications are part of the image); the 108 card-crop and supplemental captures are private and never published standalone

report_csv.meaning: per-capture actual wall time and aggregate access counts from the reviewed access addendum; no cost, no stream content, no ranking
report_csv.wall_time_label: actual, contention-affected, not an SLA or provider speed comparison (caveat W7)

opus-high/case1.name: Poor sleep with low Mg diet

ledger_inconsistencies_recorded_not_repa.rule: recorded, not repaired; a card's Evidence/gate display on these rows derives from those gates and must not be trusted blindly

case5_rule: only outcomes[0] (the exact-combination row) is shown or gradable; every other case-5 row is component/treatment context, DO_NOT_GRADE, never averaged into any number or headline; case 5 raw JSON still contains those context rows

caveats_verbatim_from_reviewed_addendum.C1: A WebFetch with is_error=false is NOT access: HTTP 4xx, unfollowed redirects, captcha/cookie walls and Haiku refusals all arrive is_error=false.
caveats_verbatim_from_reviewed_addendum.W1: WebFetch returns a Haiku 4.5 summary written to the agent's prompt, not the verbatim original page; inventory.access="full_text" therefore means "a model-summarised view of a full-text page". Spot-checks verified claim-vs-tool-summary, NOT claim-vs-original-paper and NOT clinical validation.
caveats_verbatim_from_reviewed_addendum.W2: ID-match diagnostics in report.json are mechanical and noisy (bare IDs, truncated DOIs with parentheses, junk captures such as doi:...&resulttype=core). Never present "N unmatched" as hallucination. sonnet-xhigh/case3 "11 not string-matched" is an artefact.
caveats_verbatim_from_reviewed_addendum.W3: Composite / non-standard / bare-numeric inventory IDs are kept unresolved; no DOI/PMID link is synthesised for them. Even clean IDs are syntax-only; resolution to the cited title is unverified.
caveats_verbatim_from_reviewed_addendum.W4: Internal ledger inconsistencies are recorded, not repaired; a later scorer must not trust `gates` blindly on those rows.
caveats_verbatim_from_reviewed_addendum.W5: Case 5: only the exact-combination row is eligible; component/treatment rows are context and must never feed a product-level number or averaged headline.
caveats_verbatim_from_reviewed_addendum.W6: opus-high/case2: Lopresti 2019 is access="abstract" taken from WebSearch-returned abstract text (see its id row); defensible but borderline against "snippet".
caveats_verbatim_from_reviewed_addendum.W7: Timing is actual-run, non-SLA, contention-affected (two models per case ran concurrently); ended-minus-started also includes post-processing. Not a provider speed comparison.
caveats_verbatim_from_reviewed_addendum.W8: Use stream tool counts, not audit.searches_run (model self-report), and never present stream counts as "model searches run".
caveats_verbatim_from_reviewed_addendum.U1: Unique content-bearing URLs / page keys are not distinct papers; guideline/factsheet/registry/query pages are counted separately where possible; no "papers read" count exists in this addendum.
caveats_verbatim_from_reviewed_addendum.U2: Experimental, unvalidated benchmark rubric; not clinical advice; no provider ranking; no timing SLA; Claude-only (Haiku 4.5 appears only as the web-tool summariser).

render.what: each audit's outcomes[0] fed through the app's unchanged /scan evidence-ledger card (real components, a browser-side route fixture, no server model call); outside-the-card overlay carries the qualifications
render.viewport: 390x844 CSS px, device scale factor 2, mobile, touch, light
render.not_current_main: these cards are the /scan card at the render commit, NOT the current deployed /scan (main has since merged a new landing and EN/LT localization)
render.fixture_field_mapping: Typed (source:'manual') fixture field mapping, exactly as build_fixtures.mjs wrote it (fixtures NOT rebuilt by the disclosure fix): input.form_label = bundled.product.name (the bundle product name, e.g. 'Magnesium bisglycinate'; case 5: 'Combination: vitamin D3 + vitamin C + zinc gluconate' is a product name, not a form); input.form = product.form = bundled.product.form (bundle form text); input.ingredient / ingredient_label = frozen addendum ingredient. The in-card 'FORM <label>' jar text and the 'What you entered' Form row therefore read input.form_label (product name); only the supplemental page-context captures draw that slot. The 'Form as supplied' line in the top banner of every composition is the frozen addendum input (supplied_input_frozen.form), preserved unchanged. Chosen option: record the mapping (no re-run), per the fix card.
render.production_wording: 'Retained audit · not reverified' is the existing production card wording; these are NOT production retained audits: non-production fixture that bypasses the production matcher.
render.non_production_fixture_notice: Playwright route fixture answers POST /api/scan with a typed ScanAnalysis-shaped payload whose ledger_audit is the benchmark audit. It deliberately bypasses the production retained-audit matcher (exact printed-dose matches for creatine / vitamin D3 / magnesium glycinate only). Non-production; no expansion of production retained-audit authorization; no numeric or clinical authority.

render_negative_control.meaning: a deliberately mutated fixture; the failures are the expected detection, not a defect
